Maya: Quick sync 1-pager + webinar hero for the latency vs $/token bench. Need one-line hero, three micro-charts, and two CTAs for inbound routing.

Zane: Proposed micro-charts: 1) compact latency violin by deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), 2) $/1k waterfall showing model + infra + optimizations, 3) persona grid (Startup/Scale/Enterprise) with p95 and $/1k.

Omar: Data ask: CSV headers = model,deployment,quant,seq_bucket,median_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_hit_rate,batch_profile. Prompt mix = 60/30/10 short/med/long. Will upload sample.

Rita: Visuals: keep captions <=10 words, use accent color for optimization bars, annotate cache savings (e.g., "cache hit -> ~40% lower $/token"). Include a tiny appendix with reproducibility snippet.

BenchBot: Schema preview OK. Note: set missing cache_hit_rate to 0. Upload ETA tomorrow 11:30 UTC.

Maya: Hero options (ultra-short):
- H1: "Predictable latency. Measurable economics."
- H2: "Promise latency. Lower your $/token."
Pick one for slide, other for social.

Zane: I like H1 for deck. H2 for tweet.

Omar: CSV path (preview): s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/6067890123.csv. Will include cache/no-cache rows and batch profiles.

Rita: CTAs for 1-pager: 1) "Run your prompts  See your numbers" 2) "Request a Dedicated eval". Inbound tag = bench-webinar-6067890123.

Maya: Timeline: hero + captions by EOD, CSV by tomorrow noon, mockups after that. I'll stitch and send to ops on Fri. Thanks team. :rocket:
